title: Nested Gibson Assembly
author: Erin Garza
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbikikcw

steps.title: Design PCR Primer Pairs
steps.instruction: Select new primer pairs to amplify multiple fragments that have already been ligated together from a failed Gibson reaction to reduce the total number of pieces for the next assembly.

steps.title: Amplify Ligated Fragments via PCR
steps.instruction: Run PCR reactions using the chosen primer pairs and the failed Gibson Assembly as the template.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the reaction mixture: 25 μl PrimeSTAR Max DNA mastermix, 22 μl DI water, 1 μl Forward primer [10 μM], 1 μl Reverse primer [10 μM], and 1 μl Failed Gibson Reaction (50 μl Total).
Set cycling conditions: 98°C for 10 sec, Tm-5°C for 15 sec, and 72°C for 10 sec/kb for 30 cycles.

steps.title: Verify PCR Success
steps.instruction: Run the amplified PCR fragments on a 0.8% - 1% agarose gel to ensure each reaction was successful.

substeps.instruction: If a PCR reaction failed, repeat the process with different primer pairs to amplify a different set of fragments together.

steps.title: Purify PCR Products
steps.instruction: Purify the remainder of each PCR reaction using a Zymo Research DNA Clean and Concentrator kit.

steps.title: Perform Nested Gibson Assembly
steps.instruction: Set up the Gibson Assembly in a PCR tube and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the mixture: 1 μl of each DNA fragment (diluted to 30 fmol), 5 μl Gibson Assembly Master mix (NEB), and x μl DI water to reach a 10 μl total volume.
Incubate the assembly in a thermocycler at 50°C for 1 h.

steps.title: Transform Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Transform the assembled DNA into chemically competent cells.

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 μl Gibson Assembly with 25 μl NEB 5-alpha chemically competent cells and hold on ice for 5-10 min.
Heat shock cells at 45°C for 30 sec and immediately place back on ice for 5 min.
Add 270 μl SOC to the cells and incubate at 37°C for 1 h.

steps.title: Plate and Incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Plate 50 μl of cells on an LB plate containing the appropriate antibiotics and grow overnight at 37°C.

steps.title: Verify Assembled Plasmids
steps.instruction: Grow resulting colonies in LB broth with antibiotics and verify the assembled plasmids.

substeps.instruction: Perform colony PCR, restriction digestions, and/or sequencing for verification.
